title: Stone for the works
The master builder's yard
summary: The works of {settlement} are stalled. The master builder needs {count} × {item} hauled to the yard.
offer: Half my builds are standing still for want of stone, and the carters want paying in gold. Haul {count} × {item} to the yard, and I pay fair.
complete: That gets two builds moving again. Come back — there is always work in a growing town.
